seed_items.canon_label_hint: Action confirmation and reversibility classification matrix
exact_items: Confirmation levels: none, light, strong, hard_gate
Reversibility classes: immediate_undo, compensating_action_only, non_reversible
none: safe navigation/focus/low-risk presentation, no user-data mutation
light: moderate-impact, accidental activation plausible, short confirm enough
strong: discard local state, remove artifacts/worktrees, revoke accepted state, materially change live execution
hard_gate: must go through canonical approval/blocked flow, cannot be bypassed
immediate_undo: direct undo/revert path within practical window
compensating_action_only: no true undo but later action changes system back/restores equivalent behavior
non_reversible: destroys durable/live state not directly undoable
notes: No shared action policy spanning runtime, Orchestrator, Source Control, cleanup, review/governance currently
